en-US: Preview Paw mode with lightweight personality and memory, quiet discoveries, visible activity, and user-confirmed note actions.
Improve plugin setup with dedicated settings navigation, declarative native-style configuration, and generic AI and public HTTPS capabilities.
Make image uploads faster and reliably merge later uploads into adjacent galleries on web and mobile.
Polish editing with visible italic text, separate custom-theme code backgrounds from quotes, preserved focus after note creation, and remembered document outline visibility.
Clarify settings with a Paw beta badge, a privacy notice for AI models, and a more consistent visual hierarchy.
Improve self-hosted reliability by deriving credential encryption from authentication, reporting the deployment source, and aligning memo timestamps with the selected sort mode.
zh-CN: 新增 Paw 模式预览：提供轻量个性与记忆、静默发现、活动展示及需用户确认的笔记操作。
改进插件设置：新增独立设置入口、声明式原生风格配置，并开放通用 AI 与公共 HTTPS 能力。
提升图片上传速度，并在 Web 与移动端将后续上传可靠合并到相邻图库。
优化编辑体验：恢复斜体显示、分离自定义主题中的代码与引用背景、新建笔记后保持焦点，并记住文档大纲显示状态。
优化设置界面：为 Paw 添加 Beta 标识、增加 AI 模型隐私提示，并统一视觉层级。
提升自托管可靠性：从认证信息派生凭据加密、展示部署来源，并让备忘录时间戳与所选排序方式一致。
